svg.title: Rigid-sphere Hertz contact on a finite Hex8 block
svg.desc: True-scale deformed finite-element mesh colored by downward displacement, active nodal reactions, and a log-log comparison of CoupFE force with the analytic Hertz law.
svg.text: Rigid-sphere Hertz contact on a finite Hex8 block
Corrected E–ν material mapping · frictionless nodal penalty contact · finite-block approximation to an elastic half-space
True-scale deformation · exterior faces colored by actual downward displacement −uz
active nodal reaction (marker size follows magnitude)
Logarithmic axes · five retained load states
2601 nodes · 2048 Hex8 · 25 active nodes · max free residual 5.2e-08
Checked solver output · finite block and nodal contact are not a mesh/domain-converged pressure solution · no smoothing
